name: nova-terra
description: Nova Terra, plateforme municipale (24h by Webcup 2026) : React 19 + Vite 7 + Tailwind 4 / AdonisJS 6 + MySQL, déployable HODI (Hodifly/Passenger)

scripts.postinstall: npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
